comparator.route: Ordinary three-year Dentistry bachelor including preclinical and supervised patient treatment
comparator.sourceNotes: The official year pages itemize 60+60+60=180 EC. Year one consists of 60 EC compulsory orientation, academic/professional formation, dental knowledge, medical–dental interaction and two preclinical dental components. Year two has 57 EC compulsory professional formation, dental knowledge, medical–dental interaction, preclinical training and the 7-EC Bachelor Clinic, plus a genuinely unrestricted 3-EC elective. Radboud specifies supervised patient treatment beginning in the second semester. Year three has 60 EC compulsory academic/professional and research work, dental knowledge, medical–dental interaction, preclinical training, an 11-EC third-year clinic and pain. The year-three page says students work on a bachelor thesis, and itemizes a 10.5-EC research/formation component but no separate thesis line; no additional thesis credits have been invented. The publicly listed year pages do not identify a prospective academic year and should not be treated as a fixed entrant-cohort contract. The adopted 2026–27 OER independently confirms the curriculum’s APPV, dental-knowledge, medical–dental-interaction, preclinical and clinic learning lines; it does not alter the settled 180-EC reconstruction. alternatives.concept: Study the biological and medical foundations relevant to oral health through cell biology, biochemistry, physiology, anatomy, neurobiology, pharmacology, immunity, pathology, epidemiology, laboratory work and evidence synthesis. This is a related-fields response to Dentistry: it does not teach dental anatomy, restorative materials and procedures, radiology, preclinical dental technique or supervised treatment of patients.

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: The first route is organised around biomedical mechanisms of health and disease. The second replaces ten molecular, anatomical, physiological, immunological and laboratory courses with social psychology, leadership, communication, sociology, qualitative research, AI ethics and behavioural decision-making. Each route therefore has 75 EC not present in the other, above the 30-EC floor.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The historical judgment correctly identified the absence of dental and clinical training but treated that absence as excluding any complete UCR response. A biomedical oral-health route and a distinct health-psychology and communication route are coherent, evidence-backed and mechanically feasible, and differ by ten courses each. The next candidate is the defining clinical and preclinical dentistry direction; UCR cannot implement it, so production stops at two and preserves that limitation explicitly.

notes.text: Radboud Dentistry combines dental theory, preclinical technical training, radiology, behavioural and medical science, supervised patient treatment and professional formation. UCR can build coherent programmes around biomedical oral-health questions or the psychological, communicative and social dimensions of care, but neither programme teaches dentistry, offers dental procedures or patient treatment, or leads toward qualification as a dentist.

The required Radboud preclinical and clinic sequence has no UCR counterpart. UCR biomedical, psychology, communication and leadership courses are shown only as related academic study; they are not substitutes for oral examination, dental radiology, restorative materials and procedures, manual dental technique or supervised clinical care.
